headline: Sunday in Branson: cool, clear fall skies with a high of 90°F
lede: Sunday, October 11 brings bright, cool fall weather to the lake with a high near 90°F, low humidity, and zero chance of rain. A perfect day for outdoor shows, a relaxed drive along the Strip, or a scenic meal with a view.
